annotations.title: Run one pass of La Lice

description: Send the whole run of your knight for one pass: frames = {"1": {part_id: {position?, rotation?}}, ...} up to frame 64 (0.25 s apart), poses in the lane's frame (start at z 0, finish line at z 10; frame 0 is your forged pose; a part keeps its last pose). The first pass locks your knight. Returns the full judgement: distance, where and why the run stopped, posts cut, bell, blows, wet feet and your trunk's path. After the third pass the card is sealed.
name: lice_run
